findings: In `formation.text` and `uncertainties[0].text`, clarify the exact scope of the disputed sound-role proposal: it applies to the combined graphic unit printed after 冖, whose Unicode identity remains unresolved, not to either 臼 individually or to 学 as a whole. Cite X-d76eda27ab40700bed32. The current text says “a following unidentified printed graphic unit” and describes the unit as sound-bearing, but does not say it is combined; that distinction is supported by the cited source.
